remarks: Enjoy a peaceful, private setting in The Common with fountain views and mature landscaping. This versatile studio features a cozy sleeping alcove, a sunlit living room that opens to a private patio, and a beautifully renovated bathroom. In-unit washer/dryer, a California-Closet walk-in, and an on-site storage unit provide exceptional convenience. The grounds feel like living in a park. HOA covers heat, hot water, grounds maintenance, trash, and snow removal. Ideally located near shops, restaurants, I-95, Metro-North, and Tod's Point beach.
